name: AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
notes: AWS announced the New Zealand cloud region is open, with three availability zones and infrastructure in/around Auckland. Public MW capacity was not disclosed.

name: Microsoft New Zealand North Cloud Region
notes: Microsoft opened its first hyperscale cloud region in New Zealand, described as the New Zealand North region in Auckland. No public MW capacity found.

name: DCI Data Centers AKL01
notes: DCI announced completion of AKL01 in Westgate, Auckland; trade coverage reports 10 MW of capacity and DCI's Auckland page lists AKL01 as one of its local data centres.

name: DCI Data Centers AKL02
notes: DCI's Auckland page lists AKL02 on Auckland's North Shore, scheduled for early 2025 delivery; trade coverage reported groundbreaking for a 40 MW AKL02 facility.

name: NEXTDC AK1 Auckland
notes: NEXTDC lists AK1 Auckland / New Zealand Data Centre as in development. Public MW capacity was not found on the operator page.

name: CDC Data Centres Auckland Campuses
notes: CDC's Auckland location page lists Silverdale Campus One at 22 MW operating capacity, Hobsonville Campus One at 22 MW, and Hobsonville Campus Two at 54 MW, with 220 MW+ regional capacity identified across highly connected Auckland campuses.

name: Datacom Orbit Data Centre
notes: Datacom lists Orbit as its Auckland North data centre and says the facility delivers up to 10 MW of power.

name: Vocus Albany Data Centre
notes: Vocus offers colocation/data centre services and directory/trade sources identify its Albany, Auckland 7A/7C data centre. No public MW capacity found.

name: TenPeaks Auckland South / Takanini Data Centre
notes: Spark's market announcement confirms its data centre assets transferred to TenPeaks; directory listings identify the Takanini/Auckland South site. Portfolio-level capacity is 23 MW across 11 facilities, but site-specific MW was not found.

name: Spark / TenPeaks Mayoral Drive Data Centre
notes: Spark's data centre business transferred to TenPeaks in 2026; Cloudscene identifies an Auckland Mayoral Drive facility. Public site-specific MW capacity was not found.

name: Spark / TenPeaks Tauranga Data Centre
notes: Spark confirmed its data centre portfolio transfer to TenPeaks; directory listings identify the Tauranga CBD/Cameron Road facility. Site-specific MW was not found.

name: ECO Data Centre Tauranga
notes: Data centre directories list ECO Data Centre in Tauranga, including as a nearby facility to Chorus EdgeCentre Tauranga. Public MW capacity and primary operator page were not found.

name: Chorus Tauranga EdgeCentre
notes: Chorus states EdgeCentre is available in Tauranga and describes the service as a regional distributed data centre; directory listings place the Tauranga EdgeCentre at 215 Otumoetai Road. No public MW capacity found.

name: Datacom Gloucester Data Centre
notes: Datacom's Gloucester Christchurch page identifies the central Christchurch facility and lists 1 MW capacity; trade coverage reported the Gloucester expansion.

name: DataGrid North Rakaia Data Centre Campus
notes: DataGrid/T4 Group's South Island project near Rakaia has been reported as a hyperscale campus with renewable energy tie-ins and up to about 100 MW; sources describe it as planned/development.

name: Spark / TenPeaks Christchurch Data Centre
notes: Spark's data centre business transferred to TenPeaks in 2026; Cloudscene identifies a Christchurch facility. Public site-specific MW capacity was not found.

name: Chorus Christchurch EdgeCentre
notes: Chorus states EdgeCentre facilities are located in Christchurch and describes the service as regional distributed data centre/colocation. No public MW capacity found.

name: Spark NZ Gisborne Data Centre
developer: Spark New Zealand / TenPeaks Data Centres
notes: Spark confirmed transfer of its national data centre portfolio to TenPeaks; Inflect lists Spark NZ Gisborne at 52 Customhouse Street. Site-specific MW capacity was not found.

name: Chorus Hastings Exchange Data Centre
notes: Data centre directories list Chorus Hastings/HBN exchange as an active data centre or edge location in Hastings. No public MW capacity found.

name: Chorus Blenheim Exchange Data Centre
notes: DataCentersList tracks Chorus Blenheim Exchange (BM) as an active Chorus data centre/facility in Marlborough District. No primary facility page or public MW capacity found.

name: Advantage Palmerston North Data Centre
notes: Data Center Map and PeeringDB identify Advantage's Palmerston North facility, with colocation/interconnection details and address information. Public MW capacity was not found from a primary source.

name: Chorus Nelson Exchange Data Centre
notes: DataCentersList tracks Chorus Nelson Exchange (NN) and Stoke Exchange (STK) as active Chorus data centre/facilities in Nelson City. No primary facility page or public MW capacity found.

name: Chorus Whangarei Exchange Data Centre
notes: DataCentersList tracks Chorus Kensington and Whangarei exchanges as active Chorus data centre/facilities in Whangarei District. No primary facility page or public MW capacity found.
